method: Independent full-manifest audit, exact-STL hash verification, read-only mesh/bed replay for all four parts, sealed standard wall evidence for all four parts, and fresh explicit 0.16-mm requested-voxel replay of the exact repaired rear shell.
acceptance: Every exact sealed STL must be one connected, watertight, manifold, consistently wound positive-volume shell that fits the declared bed.
Standard wall evidence must pass all four exact parts and a fresh fine rear-shell replay must pass the 0.8-mm threshold on the current repaired rear STL.
The fine report must name the current round-4 rear STL, whose hash differs from the rejected round-3 rear STL.
Hollowability warnings are optimization observations, not successful-print evidence; no slicer, support, print, fit, snap, warping, strength, or cycle claim may be inferred.
